causal_paths.input: global project changes or a scope/case request
transitions: frontend reads the existing project context
service scopes every query by tenant/domain/project
outputs: only current project/domain enabled-system tree and records are returned

causal_paths.input: directory/range/case CRUD, filter, import or export request
transitions: service validates tree depth and parent scope
transaction writes owned table rows or validates full workbook before writes
page renders compact tree/list from paginated API data
outputs: independent scope/case trees with bounded depth
validated CRUD, filtered export, and atomic import

causal_paths.input: scope code or case scope changes, or a case is created/imported
transitions: service allocates non-reused serial or rewrites affected case code prefix
database unique index commits all related records together
outputs: scope code is unique and each case code keeps its scope prefix plus stable serial

causal_paths.input: case form, batch operation, rich-text content or attachment binding request
transitions: service validates visible existing scope and normalizes rich text
attachment policy resolves only active tenant/domain case
batch preview computes impact before confirmed transactional update
outputs: case details and attachment preview/download use platform contract
invalid/reference-safe behavior is reported by service

transitions: service validates authenticated enabled user and scoped entity
write transaction emits test-management audit row
outputs: unauthenticated/unauthorized access is refused and successful writes have audit evidence

interfaces.name: scope REST API
interfaces.invariant: domain and global projectId are required and every entity is tenant/domain/project scoped

interfaces.name: case REST API
interfaces.invariant: case scope must be visible, active, and in the current domain/project

interfaces.name: participating-system lookup
interfaces.invariant: only enabled non-deleted entries can own a scope or case

interfaces.name: attachment binding/access
consumers: case service and common preview/download UI
interfaces.invariant: only an active case in the requester tenant/domain with cases authority can expose a file

interfaces.name: rich-text editor
interfaces.invariant: stored HTML is normalized before persistence and detail/edit use the same representation

assumptions.text: Existing scope/cases menu routes and authority parents from V80 remain active.
assumptions.evidence: V80 declares all four domain scope/cases routes and authorities; plan controller follows the same authority pattern.
assumptions.falsifier: local runtime menu/API authorization lacks the declared permissions

assumptions.text: Existing global project context is available to new pages without a second selector.
assumptions.evidence: user explicitly required reuse and existing plan/config pages already consume project context.
assumptions.falsifier: the page cannot obtain a selected project from the current store

assumptions.text: AttachmentGateway can bind a new TEST_CASE business type when a module-local access policy is registered.
assumptions.evidence: TestPlanService and TestPlanAttachmentPolicy demonstrate the same extension mechanism.
assumptions.falsifier: attachment registry rejects the policy or binding at local runtime

assumptions.text: No execution persistence is currently owned by this scope, so non-invalid scope/case state defaults to 未执行.
assumptions.evidence: approved design and V1.6 phase boundary exclude execution module.
